map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-27 03:01): mail returned 10,834 (state 10,267); early in person 27,385 (state 26,634); ballots sent 16,775 (state 16,226). Clermont (as of 2026-10-27 22:36): mail returned 10,169 (state 9,919); early in person 13,612 (state 12,255). Crawford (as of 2026-10-27 15:18): mail returned 1,650 (state 1,559); early in person 2,546 (state 2,417). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-27 18:33): mail returned 85,088 (state 82,261); early in person 32,098 (state 32,011). Franklin (as of 2026-10-27 00:12): mail returned 54,307 (state 51,803); early in person 60,687 (state 58,817); ballots sent 82,339 (state 81,193). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-26 21:44): early in person 47,730 (state 46,274). Hancock: mail returned 2,338 (state 2,222); early in person 6,911 (state 6,587). Henry (as of 2026-10-27 16:58): early in person 2,524 (state 2,259). Morrow (as of 2026-10-27 19:38): mail returned 1,110 (state 1,018); early in person 2,570 (state 2,325).
